1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=3 requires ~$300 account to risk 50% per trade on a $0.50 entry (3 contracts × $0.50 × 100 = $150; 50% of account = $150 → account=$300). Actual 2nd OTM 0DTE premiums vary; $1K paper account scales to ~42% headline P&L.
2. **Sample bias:** Selected top wide_pnl from 972 combos in-sample; high overfit risk due to selection bias. Moderate sample size but top-keeper selection inflates false-positive risk.
